May 15, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Avenir Corp increased its stake in Macquarie Infrastr Co Llc (MIC) by 12.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Avenir Corp bought 10,815 shares as the company’s stock declined 42.74% with the market. The institutional investor held 96,984 shares of the oil refining and marketing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.23M, up from 86,169 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Avenir Corp who had been investing in Macquarie Infrastr Co Llc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.21 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.49% or $0.57 during the last trading session, reaching $37.72. About 445,759 shares traded. Macquarie Infrastructure Corporation (NYSE:MIC) has declined 54.12% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.67% the S&P500.
King Luther Capital Management Corp decreased its stake in Tiffany & Co New (TIF) by 2.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. King Luther Capital Management Corp sold 19,869 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 777,081 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $80.78M, down from 796,950 at the end of the previous reported quarter. King Luther Capital Management Corp who had been investing in Tiffany & Co New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $12.75 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.60% or $0.615 during the last trading session, reaching $102.375. About 287,243 shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500.
